description: Strictly age-matched infant DMD vs infant control, plus within-DMD progression test
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, re
from scipy import stats
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
MX="GSE6011_series_matrix.txt.gz"; AN="GPL96.annot.gz"
lines=pd.read_csv(MX,compression="gzip",sep="\x01",header=None,nrows=80,dtype=str,quoting=3,engine="python")[0].tolist()
def field(n):
    for l in lines:
        if l.startswith(n+"\t"): return [x.strip('"') for x in l.split("\t")[1:]]
chars=[l for l in lines if l.startswith("!Sample_characteristics_ch1")]
S=pd.DataFrame(dict(acc=field("!Sample_geo_accession"),src=field("!Sample_source_name_ch1"),
    age=[float(re.search(r"([\d.]+)",x).group(1)) for x in chars[1].split("\t")[1:]]))
S["group"]=np.where(S.src.str.contains("normal|control",case=False),"CTRL","DMD")
ahdr=pd.read_csv(AN,compression="gzip",sep="\x01",header=None,nrows=40,dtype=str,quoting=3,engine="python")[0].tolist()
skip=[i for i,l in enumerate(ahdr) if l.startswith("ID\t")][0]
ann=pd.read_csv(AN,sep="\t",compression="gzip",skiprows=skip,dtype=str,quoting=3,on_bad_lines="skip")
sym=dict(zip(ann.ID,ann["Gene symbol"]))
expr=pd.read_csv(MX,sep="\t",compression="gzip",comment="!",index_col=0,quoting=3).dropna(how="all")
expr.index=[str(i).strip('"') for i in expr.index]; expr.columns=[c.strip('"') for c in expr.columns]
expr["sym"]=[sym.get(i) for i in expr.index]; expr=expr[expr.sym.notna()&(expr.sym!="")]
X=expr[expr.sym.notna()].groupby("sym").max().astype(float)
S=S.set_index("acc").reindex(list(X.columns))

MOD={"Fibrosis / ECM":["COL1A1","COL1A2","COL3A1","COL5A1","COL5A2","COL6A3","FN1","LUM","POSTN","TGFB1","CTGF","SPARC","BGN","FBN1","TIMP1"],
 "Inflammation / myeloid":["SPP1","CD68","CD14","TYROBP","C1QA","C1QB","C1QC","CCL2","TNF","IL1B","LGALS3","FCGR3A","AIF1","PTPRC"],
 "Regeneration / immature myofiber":["MYH3","MYH8","MYOG","MYF5","MYF6","PAX7","NCAM1","TNNT2","IGF2","MEST","DLK1","CDKN1A"],
 "Membrane repair":["DYSF","TRIM72","ANXA1","ANXA2","ANXA6","MYOF","CAV3","S100A10"],
 "Calcium-dependent proteases":["CAPN1","CAPN2","CAPN3","CAPNS1","CAST"]}
Z=X.sub(X.mean(1),axis=0).div(X.std(1).replace(0,np.nan),axis=0)
SC=pd.DataFrame({m:Z.loc[[g for g in gl if g in Z.index]].mean() for m,gl in MOD.items()})
SC["DMD_expr"]=X.loc["DMD"]; SC["age"]=S.age.values; SC["group"]=S.group.values

CUT=9.0
dY=SC[(SC.group=="DMD")&(SC.age<=CUT)]; cY=SC[(SC.group=="CTRL")&(SC.age<=CUT)]
dO=SC[(SC.group=="DMD")&(SC.age>CUT)]
print(f"STRICT age-matched infants: DMD n={len(dY)} (ages {sorted(dY.age)}), CTRL n={len(cY)} (ages {sorted(cY.age)})")
print("age difference Mann-Whitney p=%.3f" % stats.mannwhitneyu(dY.age,cY.age).pvalue)
rows=[]
for m in list(MOD)+["DMD_expr"]:
    U,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(dY[m],cY[m])
    sd=np.sqrt((dY[m].var(ddof=1)+cY[m].var(ddof=1))/2)
    # older vs younger DMD cases
    U2,p2=stats.mannwhitneyu(dO[m],dY[m])
    sd2=np.sqrt((dO[m].var(ddof=1)+dY[m].var(ddof=1))/2)
    rows.append(dict(module=m, d_infantDMD_vs_infantCTRL=(dY[m].mean()-cY[m].mean())/sd, p_strict=p,
                     d_olderDMD_vs_infantDMD=(dO[m].mean()-dY[m].mean())/sd2, p_progression=p2))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows); T["fdr_strict"]=multipletests(T.p_strict,method="fdr_bh")[1]
print("\n=== Strictly age-matched infant comparison, and within-DMD progression (older n=%d vs infant n=%d) ==="%(len(dO),len(dY)))
print(T.to_string(index=False,float_format=lambda x:f"{x:.3g}"))
T.to_csv("GSE6011_strict_agematched_infant_test.csv",index=False)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,4,figsize=(16.5,4.6))
order=["Infant\ncontrol\n(n=%d)"%len(cY),"Infant\nDMD\n(n=%d)"%len(dY),"Older\nDMD\n(n=%d)"%len(dO)]
sets=[cY,dY,dO]; cols=["#4C72B0","#C44E52","#8C3B3F"]
for ax,m in zip(axes,["Fibrosis / ECM","Inflammation / myeloid","Regeneration / immature myofiber","DMD_expr"]):
    for i,(s,col) in enumerate(zip(sets,cols)):
        v=s[m].values
        ax.scatter(np.random.RandomState(0).normal(i,.07,len(v)),v,color=col,s=40,edgecolor="k",lw=.4,zorder=3)
        ax.hlines(np.mean(v),i-.26,i+.26,color="k",lw=2,zorder=4)
    ax.set_xticks(range(3)); ax.set_xticklabels(order,fontsize=8)
    ax.set_title(m if m!="DMD_expr" else "DMD transcript (log2)",fontsize=10)
    ax.set_ylabel("module z-score" if m!="DMD_expr" else "log2 expression")
    r=T[T.module==m].iloc[0]
    ax.text(.03,.96,f"infant DMD vs infant control:\nd={r.d_infantDMD_vs_infantCTRL:.2f}, p={r.p_strict:.1e}\nolder vs infant DMD: d={r.d_olderDMD_vs_infantDMD:.2f}, p={r.p_progression:.2f}",
            transform=ax.transAxes,va="top",fontsize=7.2)
plt.suptitle("The fibro-inflammatory and regenerative programme is fully established in DMD infants aged 1.5 to 8 months and does not increase in older cases (GSE6011 quadriceps)",fontsize=10.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
